name: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Arabian Shield Cooperative Insurance Company provides various insurance products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers motor, property, engineering, marine, travel, personal accident, extended visit visa, and craftsman's insurance; medical insurance, such as health and medical malpractice insurance; and education, marriage, retirement, ladies, and investment protection and saving insurance. The Company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
